feature_name: Personalized saved reports in Cost Reports
summary: Cost Reports now surfaces frequently opened custom saved reports in the reports carousel for users with Gemini Cloud Assist enabled.
extended_definition: Cost Reports now surfaces frequently opened custom saved reports in the reports carousel for users with Gemini Cloud Assist enabled.

supporting_pages.title: "Analyze billing data and cost trends with Reports \_|\_ Cloud Billing \_\
evidence_snippets: Billing Account Administrators and Billing Account Costs Managers have full access to the Saved reports feature, and can create a new, custom saved report , open any saved report , and update , rename , and delete custom saved reports.

Saved reports are saved to the All reports page and are available for viewing by users in your organization with Cloud Billing account-level access, who can view reports for all costs and projects for the Cloud Billing account.

However, because this level of billing access doesn't allow you to view all costs for all projects linked to the Cloud Billing account, you can't create or access custom saved reports in the All reports page.

supporting_pages.title: Gemini Cloud Assist in Cloud Billing \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Saved reports To analyze your cost trends, you can select from various Google-configured and user-configured cost reports: Google Cloud offers a range of preconfigured cost reports (formerly known as Presets ) that are ready to use with a single click.

Gemini-assisted reports creation You can create custom cost reports using natural language prompts: If the saved reports don't meet your needs, you can describe the report that you want using natural language.
Additionally, if you create and save custom cost reports (previously known as Saved views ), your saved reports are also available for you and your team in the See all reports tab.
